title: music-render composition
description: A piece of music for music-render. Beats are quarter notes.

loop.description: game loop: playback returns from endBeat to startBeat; render --loop and the app's export write it into the file

ramp.description: change bpm linearly until the next point

instruments.description: registry file(s), relative to this file, or objects of instrument definitions (name to definition, as in a registry file); read after the default registry

buses.description: submix buses fed by track sends

vca.description: the VCA whose gain and mute also act on this bus

vcas.description: VCA faders: no audio passes through them; each adds its gain (and gain curve) to the faders of the tracks and buses that name it, and its mute mutes them

targetLufs.description: normalise the master to this integrated loudness before a trailing limiter (re-adjusted after it)

key.description: the first key for the score and MIDI, e.g. "Bb minor" or "F# major" (estimated from the notes when absent)

keyChanges.description: key changes on bar lines in ascending beat order

meterChanges.description: time signature changes in ascending beat order; each starts a bar of the meter before it

markers.description: named positions (section names) in ascending beat order; not used for sound

video.description: a video to write the music against; not used for sound. The video's 0 s sits at the song's offsetSeconds

file.description: .mp4, .mov or .m4v, relative to the song's folder

offsetSeconds.description: song second where the video starts (negative: the video starts before the song)

endBeat.description: song end; output length = time(endBeat) + tailSeconds

articulation.description: a name from the instrument profile

lyric.description: the syllable sung on this note, or "-" to keep singing the previous syllable. No effect on the sound

instrument.description: a name from the instrument registry, never a file path

articulation.description: default articulation for the track's notes

output.description: the bus that receives the track after its fader instead of the master (a subgroup)

folder.description: the track view folder; never changes the sound

vca.description: the VCA whose gain and mute also act on this track (a name in $.vcas)

color.description: track colour in the app; not used for sound

clips.description: audio clips of a track whose instrument is "audio"; placed in beats, played in seconds (not stretched by the tempo)

file.description: WAV, AIFF, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis or MP3, relative to the song file

offsetSeconds.description: where the clip starts inside the file

lengthSeconds.description: default: to the end of the file

reverse.description: plays the whole file backwards; every file second of the clip (offsetSeconds, lengthSeconds, warp, pitchEdits, gainCurve) counts in the reversed file, from the file's end

gainCurve.description: gain inside the clip in dB, on the file's seconds (it stays with the sound when the clip is moved, trimmed or split), added to gainDb. Outside the points it holds the end values

seconds.description: rising; two points at the same second make a jump

curve.description: shape from this point to the next (default linear)

sourceBpm.description: the file's tempo: the clip follows the song's tempo

warp.description: warp markers: the file's seconds land on beats inside the clip (only differences count; offsetSeconds plays at startBeat). Both rise

warpMode.description: stretch (default) time-stretches between warp markers; slice cuts at the markers and plays each piece unstretched (drums keep their attacks, no pitchSemitones)

pitchCorrection.description: pulls the measured pitch to the nearest semitone, or to the notes of key (or scale with root)

strength.description: share of the distance to the target (default 1)

speedMs.description: how fast the correction follows (0 flattens vibrato, default 30)

scale.description: a scale id from music-render scales

root.description: the scale's root note (C, F#, Bb)

pitchEdits.description: per-note pitch edits in the file's seconds, in time order and not overlapping (not with warpMode slice). Inside an edit it wins over pitchCorrection

seconds.description: where the note starts in the file

flatten.description: how much of the slow pitch drift is pulled to the note's centre (default 0)

vibrato.description: scale of the fast pitch movement (default 1, 0 removes the vibrato)

muted.description: a take that does not play

automation.description: cc0..cc127 (0..127), pitchBend (-1..1, ±2 semitones on the built-in synths unless the track's synth.bendRange says otherwise; the drum kits follow it too), aftertouch (0..127). Lanes can also sit directly on the track

levelDb.description: send level lane in dB (-120..12); replaces levelDb

plugin.description: settings for a plugin instrument, applied after the registry entry: state, then program, then parameters

state.description: plugin state, standard base64 (written by the app when the plugin panel changes)

parameters.description: parameter name or ID to a normalised 0..1 number or the parameter text

synth.description: values over a built-in synth preset (only the ones that differ): detune, noise, filter, filterMode, cutoffHz, resonance, filterEnvHz, filterEnvDecay, filterVelHz, keytrack, attack, decay, sustain, release, vibratoRate, vibratoCents, vibratoDelay, bendRange, pitchEnv, pitchEnvDecay, mono, glide, drive, velocityCurve, spread, levelDb, decayLow, decayHigh (piano, pluck), tune (drum kits)

filterMode.description: subtractive presets: which output of the filter is heard (CC74 moves the cutoff in every mode)

bendRange.description: semitones at pitchBend -1 and 1 (default 2). Subtractive presets, the modelled piano and the drum kits

pitchEnv.description: subtractive presets: semitones above the note where each new note starts, falling to the note in pitchEnvDecay seconds (synth.808: 12)

mono.description: subtractive presets: 1 plays one voice. A note that overlaps a held note glides to it (glide seconds, no new attack), a note after a gap cuts the previous one (synth.808: 1)

glide.description: mono: seconds to slide to an overlapping note, straight in semitones (synth.808: 0.08)

tune.description: drum kits: semitones that move every drum (default 0). The club-drums kick body is A1 (55 Hz) at 0

legatoOverlapMs.description: extend notes followed by a note starting at their end

accentPattern.description: velocity offsets per accentGrid slot within the bar

mixer.description: pan is a stereo balance; mute applies to tracks and buses, solo to tracks

automation.description: curves that replace gainDb (dB) and pan (-1..1), read on the song position

bypass.description: skip the effect but keep its latency (the chain stays aligned)

thresholdDb.description: compressor: level where compression starts (default -18); gate: level that opens the gate, -96..0 (default -40), it closes 3 dB lower after holdMs

attackMs.description: compressor: attack (default 10); ducker: time to reach depthDb at each period start, 0..200 (default 1); gate: time to open, 0.01..100 (default 0.5)

releaseMs.description: compressor, limiter: release; gate: time to close, 1..5000 (default 120)

mix.description: compressor: parallel mix; reverb: wet amount (dry = 1 - mix, automatable); delay, distortion, filter, ducker, chorus, flanger, phaser: wet amount (automatable)

mode.description: reverb: convolution (default) or algorithmic; filter: lowpass (default), highpass, bandpass or notch

ir.description: impulse response WAV, relative to the composition; without it a hall IR is generated

width.description: reverb: stereo width 0..1; stereo: side level 0..2 (automatable)

dryDb.description: reverb: dry level in dB instead of 1 - mix (automatable)

wetDb.description: reverb: wet level in dB instead of mix (automatable)

sidechain.description: compressor: name of the track whose pre-fader signal drives the detector (for example the kick); the track must not key itself or form a loop

timeMs.description: delay: echo time in milliseconds; use timeBeats instead for a tempo-synced delay

feedback.description: delay: share of the echo fed back, 0..0.95 (automatable); chorus, flanger: -0.95..0.95, negative inverts the echo (automatable); phaser: 0..0.95 (automatable)

pingPong.description: delay: 1 bounces echoes between left and right

truePeak.description: limiter: 1 also limits peaks between samples (4x interpolation); adds 6 samples of latency

driveDb.description: distortion: gain into the tanh shaper (automatable)

toneHz.description: distortion: 12 dB/oct low-pass after the shaper

timeBeats.description: delay: echo time in beats; follows the tempo map (on a ramp the echo is always the sound timeBeats earlier); not with timeMs

cutoffHz.description: filter: cutoff (centre for bandpass and notch); automatable, points are joined in log frequency

resonance.description: filter: 0..1 maps to Q 0.7071..10 exponentially; 0 is Butterworth (-3 dB at the cutoff), 1 peaks +20 dB on a 12 dB lowpass; automatable

slope.description: filter: 12 or 24 dB per octave (one or two stages)

rateBeats.description: ducker: period in beats (0.0625..16); chorus, flanger, phaser, tremolo: LFO period in beats following the tempo map, replaces rateHz (0.0625..64)

depthDb.description: ducker: gain at the bottom of each period (automatable)

holdMs.description: ducker: time held at depthDb after the attack; gate: time kept open after the level falls 3 dB below the threshold (default 50)

releaseBeats.description: ducker: time back to 0 dB after the hold, in beats

curve.description: ducker: release shape; the remaining depth is depthDb * (1 - r)^curve, 1 is a straight line in dB, above 1 recovers fast first

offsetBeats.description: ducker: the periods start at offsetBeats + k * rateBeats

rateHz.description: chorus (default 0.8), flanger (0.2), phaser (0.4): LFO rate up to 20 Hz; tremolo (4) up to 40 Hz. The LFO phase depends only on the song position

depthMs.description: chorus (0..20, default 3), flanger (0..10, default 2): the delay swings between delayMs and delayMs + depthMs (automatable)

delayMs.description: chorus (0.5..40, default 12), flanger (0.1..20, default 1): the shortest delay

phaseDeg.description: chorus (default 90), flanger (0), phaser (90), tremolo (0): how far the right channel's LFO leads the left one; a tremolo at 180 is an auto-pan

lowHz.description: phaser: lowest corner frequency of the sweep

highHz.description: phaser: highest corner frequency of the sweep

depth.description: tremolo: the gain swings between 1 and 1 - depth (automatable)

shape.description: tremolo: LFO shape (square has rounded edges)

rangeDb.description: gate: gain while closed (-96 is silence)

automation.description: parameter lanes: parameter name to points (only parameters marked automatable: gain.gainDb, filter.cutoffHz, resonance, mix, ducker.depthDb, mix, delay.mix, feedback, reverb.mix, dryDb, wetDb, stereo.width, distortion.driveDb, mix, chorus and flanger depthMs, feedback, mix, phaser.feedback, mix, tremolo.depth). Before the first point the first value holds, after the last the last

effect.description: track effects run in the stream (their latency is aligned); bus and master effects run on the whole buffer

curve.description: shape from this point to the next

fadeShape.description: sine (default, sin squared: two opposite fades add up in amplitude), linear, equalPower (sine: two opposite fades add up in power), exponential (straight in dB from -60 dB)
